mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.bans (id, user_id, initiator_id, type, tenant_key, reason, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{initiatorId}, #{type, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{tenantKey}, #{reason}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.bans SET user_id = #{userId}, initiator_id = #{initiatorId}, type = #{type, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, tenant_key = #{tenantKey}, reason = #{reason}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, initiator_id, type, tenant_key, reason, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.bans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (tenant_key = #{tenantKey} OR tenant_key IS NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY type DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, initiator_id, type, tenant_key, reason, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.bans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'PLATFORM' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 1
